host_profile: Physical Intel Haswell Linux 6.8.0-138; original unscaled native TSC rate, matching destination rate; no guest execution

assumptions.assumption: The selected native TSC profile is unscaled and user TSC reads are permitted
assumptions.basis: Original fresh native rate, get-TSC/offset brackets and physical native execution
assumptions.stress_test: Every CPU in one/two/four graphs, both IRQchip modes, wraparound offset arithmetic
assumptions.falsification_probe: A native GET_TSC falls outside its serialized host-TSC/offset bracket or the target rate differs
assumptions.status: confirmed for the exercised native profile

assumptions.assumption: Restoring CPU TSC values independently need not retain their relative phases
assumptions.basis: Archived kernel synchronization/offset code and actual independent C negative controls
assumptions.dependent_result: Use a common delta through the direct offset attribute
assumptions.stress_test: Deliberate one-ms inter-CPU restore delay and source phase separation
assumptions.falsification_probe: Native offset readback differs from the requested common delta or any relative phase changes
assumptions.status: confirmed: eight naive phase losses; all 14 direct and 28 serialized phase controls pass

assumptions.assumption: Captured VM time and a host-TSC sample are not an atomic cross-domain observation
assumptions.basis: Serialized before/after TSC sample interval around KVM_GET_CLOCK
assumptions.dependent_result: Retain capture/publication uncertainty instead of claiming zero error
assumptions.stress_test: Divergent CPU phases clear the kernel HOST_TSC/STABLE flags in two/four-CPU cases
assumptions.falsification_probe: A zero or fabricated interval replaces the actual bracket, or HOST_TSC is assumed valid when absent

assumptions.assumption: The callback must run at a real common first-entry gate inside a complete rollback transaction
assumptions.basis: The helper has no owning VMM hook and native setters can change a prefix
assumptions.stress_test: Guest entry during or before multi-CPU publication; native setter failure after an accepted prefix
assumptions.falsification_probe: Any guest entry before completion or failed rollback without a VM-wide entry poison disproves full integration
assumptions.status: not yet established; required integration work

assumptions.assumption: CPU references supplied by the owner correspond to distinct retained CPU identities
assumptions.basis: Fresh indexed native constructors and complete ID/rate preflight
assumptions.stress_test: Duplicate/reordered IDs, missing CPUs, mismatched rates, huge binary counts
assumptions.falsification_probe: An aliased native FD or changed CPU identity is accepted as a complete owning graph
assumptions.status: confirmed for the exercised constructors; complete owning-graph association remains required
